test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Augmented Reality (AR) continues to develop and become more _________ among a wide range of applications.
solution:
The correct answer is: **pervasive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"pervasive"** means something that is spreading widely throughout an area or a group of people. (व्यापक)

 
 
• **Example: **The influence of social media is pervasive in today's society.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that the field of augmented reality, or AR, is growing and becoming increasingly commonplace in a variety of applications.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rare **(दुर्लभ): Something that is not common or frequently encountered.

 
 
• **Example:** Sightings of the rare bird are becoming increasingly uncommon.
 
 
 
• **Amicable **(मैत्रीपूर्ण): Characterized by friendliness and absence of discord.
 
 
• **Example: **They reached an amicable agreement after hours of negotiation.
 
 
 
• **Idealistic** (आदर्शवादी): Characterized by idealism; unrealistically aiming for perfection.
 
 
• **Example:** His idealistic views often clashed with the harsh realities of the world.
